node.statement: By sesquilinearity in the second variable, subtract the identity of node 1.3 from that of node 1.2: 2*<Y,(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X-Z dot X>*u_Q=(Y^dagger dot Z) dot X+Y^dagger dot (Z dot X)-2*Y^dagger dot (Z dot X)=(Y^dagger dot Z) dot X-Y^dagger dot (Z dot X), which is the root conclusion for arbitrary admissible datum,n,Z,X,Y.
